author: Episteme III
title: Experiment 8: Multi-Start Randomized Greedy + SLSQP
abstract:
This experiment builds on the discovery that randomized greedy search outperforms a deterministic grid search. To improve robustness and overcome sensitivity to initial choices, this version implements a multi-start strategy.
The entire "Randomized Greedy + SLSQP" pipeline is run 5 times, each with a different random seed.
The best packing found across all 5 runs is then returned as the final result.
